---
title: "Download the data"
subtitle: "Every saved update and every table, free"
---

Every number on this site can be rebuilt from these files, and all of them
are free to download.

::: {.link-row}
[Raw and parsed files (Releases)](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/releases)
[Daily figures and maps (data branch)](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/tree/data)
[License](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/blob/main/LICENSE-DATA.md)
:::

Each release on GitHub holds one month of files, with one file per day: the
raw archive is in `raw-YYYY-MM` and the parsed tables are in
`parsed-YYYY-MM`. When we started collecting, Island Transit's feeds came
with no license or terms of use.

## Archived days

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {json} from "./lib.js"
raw = json("data/manifest/raw.json")
rows = raw == null ? [] : Object.values(raw.days).map(d => ({
  day: d.service_date, fetches: d.fetch_rows, ok: d.ok_rows,
  megabytes: d.files.reduce((a, f) => a + f.bytes, 0) / 1e6,
  release: d.release_tag}))
html`${rows.length === 0 ? html`<p>No day has been archived yet.</p>` : Inputs.table(rows.reverse(), {
  header: {day: "Service day", fetches: "Fetch attempts", ok: "Successful", megabytes: "Size (MB)", release: "Release"},
  format: {megabytes: d => d.toFixed(1)}, rows: 20})}`
```

## Monthly reports

Once a month is over, we write up a summary of it and add a checksum file
to its downloads, so you can confirm that your copies match ours.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {pct} from "./lib.js"
reports = json("data/reports/index.json")
reportBase = "https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/blob/data/reports/"
reportRows = (reports ?? []).map(r => ({...r, megabytes: r.bytes / 1e6})).reverse()
html`${reportRows.length === 0 ? html`<p>No month is complete yet.</p>` : Inputs.table(reportRows, {
  columns: ["month", "days_archived", "days_missing", "vehicle_uptime", "trip_coverage",
            "timepoint_observed_share", "on_time_share_of_observed", "megabytes"],
  header: {month: "Month", days_archived: "Days archived", days_missing: "Days missing",
           vehicle_uptime: "Collector uptime", trip_coverage: "Trip coverage",
           timepoint_observed_share: "Timepoint events observed",
           on_time_share_of_observed: "On time (of observed)", megabytes: "Size (MB)"},
  format: {month: m => html`<a href="${reportBase}${m}.md">${m}</a>`,
           vehicle_uptime: x => pct(x, 2), trip_coverage: x => pct(x, 1),
           timepoint_observed_share: x => pct(x, 1), on_time_share_of_observed: x => pct(x, 1),
           megabytes: d => d.toFixed(1)}})}`
```
